title: Ridgeline Warranty Coverage Handling Surcharge by Factory Build Class
content:
On a technician visit whose trip charge Warranty Coverage bills, a handling surcharge applies according to the build class in which the factory built the covered units, as the Factory Production Orders records show for the order that built them:

| Build class of the covered units | Handling surcharge (USD) |
|---|---|
| Impact-Rated Build | 45.00 (impact handling surcharge) |
| Specialty Shape Build | 25.00 (specialty handling surcharge) |
| Architectural Wood Build | 25.00 (specialty handling surcharge) |
| any other build class (Custom Size Build, Custom Color Build, Specialty Glass Build) | none |

In clause form: when the covered units were built by the factory as an Impact-Rated Build, the visit takes the impact handling surcharge; when they were built as a Specialty Shape Build or an Architectural Wood Build, it takes the specialty handling surcharge; units of any other build class take no handling surcharge.

## Points of judgement

- The build class is read from the Factory Production Orders record of the order built for the contract the Warranty Coverage registration covers.
- A Specialty Glass Build is not one of the specialty handling classes for this surcharge.
